subject: Initiative tilt, risk allocations & budget sprint — annual planning kickoff
body:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initiative tilt, risk allocations & budget sprint — annual planning kickoff

Team — kicking off annual planning & budget workstream for FY28. Goal here is to get to a tight set of scenario budgets and initiative-level tilts by the end of the June sprint so execs have clean tradeoffs going into QBR. High-level asks and timeline below: 

1) Outcomes we need by June 25:
- Prioritized list of initiatives with owners and delta budget (base / optimistic / downside)
- Headcount ask per initiative and associated hiring phasing
- Quantified risk buckets (supply: infra cost, demand: bookings, product: model quality) with contingency triggers
- QBR slide deck draft (one slide per initiative + executive summary)

2) Timeline (working sprint)
- Jun 7: Kickoff email + shared workbook (attached) — owners assigned
- Jun 9–14: Initiative owners submit base/optimistic/downside lines in workbook
- Jun 15–18: Cross-functional triage (GC, Finance, Product) to reconcile assumptions
- Jun 21: Leadership pre-read circulation
- Jun 24–25: Exec QBR run-through and decisioning

3) Immediate asks (this week):
- Laura: please own Platform & Reliability initiative lines and the infra cost sensitivity model (see tab: InfraSens).
- Marissa: lead Product GTM tilt and confirm customer expansion assumptions (related to Atlas Analytics pilot).
- Vivek: own go/no-go gating for Dedicated capacity investments and staffing phasing.
- Soojin: pull hiring capacity constraints and deliver H1->H2 ramp scenarios.

Attachments: 2027-initiative-tilt-scenarios.xlsx (workbook with tabs: Initiatives, InfraSens, Headcount, QBR-Slides)

Calendar: I scheduled a 60m planning sync (Jun 9 10:00 PT) — link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/annual-planning-kickoff-2027

Please add owners in the Owners column in the workbook by end of day Thursday. If you foresee blockers (procurement, SOC2 evidence, marketplace approvals), flag them inline in the workbook so we can escalate early.

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
VP, Strategy & Planning
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Sent: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Initiative tilt, risk allocations & budget sprint — annual planning kickoff

Jonas — confirmed. I populated Platform & Reliability with baseline numbers and two sensitivity cases (low/no growth infra price cut and high GPU spot volatility). Notes inline in tab InfraSens. Two questions for finance: should we model a 10% reserved capacity discount for Dedicated for the optimistic case? If so, I added a line item but left it off the base.

Also attaching a short infra assumptions list for the QBR slide.

Laura

Attachment stubs: infra-assumptions-brief.pdf

Adding comments from GTM side:
- Atlas Analytics pilot: expect +$120k ARR in optimistic, $45k base, risk downside 0 for churn probability assumptions. I've confirmed the procurement contact (Alicia Gomez) will provide signed SOW draft by Jun 18 — looped Alicia here.
- Suggest we create a short 'deployment cost per customer' line on the slide — it helps tradeoff Dedicated vs Hosted for small-mid customers.

I'll own the customer economics slide.

Marissa

-----Original Message-----
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@atlasanalytics.com>
Sent: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -05:00
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai; jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@zencloud.com
Subject: Re: Initiative tilt, risk allocations & budget sprint — annual planning kickoff

Thanks for the update Marissa — Atlas is aligned to a pilot SOW timeline and procurement will push a draft this week. For budgeting, we expect to scale to three production customers by Q4 in the optimistic case; I'll share our internal forecast once procurement completes the SOW.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Director of Analytics, Atlas Analytics

Quick note on Dedicated capacity: I've added a gating checklist in the workbook (tab: DedicatedGate). Key items: marketplace listing cadence, estimated MTTI for Dedicated nodes, legal terms for customer data separation. If we cannot confirm KMS integration by Jun 18, we should flag Dedicated as 'defer' in downside.

Vivek

Heads-up on hiring constraints: recruiting capacity drops the hiring throughput by ~25% in Jul due to campus recruiting events. I've modeled phasing in Headcount tab which shifts some hiring from Jul->Sep. If headcount timing materially changes initiative delivery, flag it in the workbook and we will re-run the ramp.

Sooj
